decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	With appropriate safeguarding conditions the proposal is considered acceptable because of its size, function and would not harm the appearance of the site or the surrounding area, and would serve to further the educational operations of Hounslow Town Primary School.  The development is therefore in accordance with policy ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), C.2.1 (Educational Facilities) and ENV-N.1.11 (Protection and Improvement of Local Open Space) of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
description: Demolition of temporary classrooms and erection of a single storey rear extension to school
